messages:
jordan: Quick thread 18:30 UTC canary for v2.16.0 tomorrow. Draft release notes: https://workspace.redwood/release/v2.16.0-draft. Quiet window 18:15-19:45 UTC. Planning internal announce ~19:00 UTC. Please flag anything customer-facing.

deploybot: /deploy canary v2.16.0 --targets=canary-12 --timeout=20m
deploybot: Canary started: v2.16.0 -> canary-12 (12 hosts). Watching p95, p99, 5xx, memory.

sasha: Note: we changed the default quantization profile for CPU fallbacks; add a short note under "Compatibility" so customers know inference results are unchanged but perf may differ slightly on CPU.

jordan: added compatibility blurb under Deployment details.

mina: Ops: Dedicated fleets will be pinned to `redwood-runtime@2026-03-01` for the GA window. Add timeline: "expected unpin 10 business days after GA; contact your SE for exceptions."

support-lead: Can we add a "Suggested support copy" section for the support queue: one-line answers for "Why was my runtime pinned?" and "Will my latency change?"

sasha: I'll draft suggested replies and paste here.

sasha: Suggested: "Runtime pinning reduces variability during rollout; we plan to unpin after a stability window. If you see unexpected latency, please open a ticket and include request id and timing"

ops-oncall: Rollback thresholds for this rollout: auto-rollback if 5xx >= 0.18% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency +40% for 10m. Manual rollback requires release owner + ops sign-off. I'll be oncall 18:00-20:30 UTC (PD_Rollout).

deploybot: Canary health update @12m: p95 +5%, p99 +10%, 5xx 0.04%, memory stable. No auto-rollback.

mina: Legal reviewed the customer-facing blurb for the new KMS integration; ok to ship as-is. Added approved sentence to notes.

jordan: thanks. Adding runbook link: https://confluence.company/ops/runbooks/v2.16-rollout. Also adding a tiny "Known issue" note: observed p99 tail increase in canary that is within thresholds; monitoring.

support-lead: Adding support checklist: how to gather logs, which fields to include, and escalation steps. Pasted into draft.

jordan: Final internal announce copy (posting to #eng-releases at 18:50 UTC):
"Internal: staged rollout v2.16.0 starting with canary at 18:30 UTC. Canary healthy and promoting to staged rollout pending stability. Quiet window 18:15-19:45 UTC. Key notes: Dedicated runtime pinned to redwood-runtime@2026-03-01; CPU fallback quantization profile change noted under Compatibility; KMS blurb approved by legal. Rollback criteria & runbook: https://confluence.company/ops/runbooks/v2.16-rollout. Oncall: ops-oncall (PD_Rollout). Support copy in release notes. Public announce planned 19:15 UTC"

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll trigger rollback if thresholds exceeded and will notify in this thread.

sasha: LGTM.

mina: LGTM.

jordan: Posting internal announce now and queuing public announce. Thanks everyone :rocket:

deploybot: /announce internal "v2.16.0 staged rollout 18:30 UTC canary healthy, promoting to staged rollout" --channel=#eng-releases --when=6865432200

jordan: bot queued and thread closed after promote.
